note: S3a verified taxonomy overlay (schema 1). Routes gap-closers/CC/defensives/self-sustain only; never Main. Defensive tiers: minor = Yellow+, major = Red, immunity = last resort. CC stuns/silences are gated to casting/fleeing non-boss targets; incapacitates/fears/roots stay manual in groups. Never-automatic abilities stay Never whatever this file says. Every Auto/Suggest id is verified against spell-verification.json.

entries.notes: Wild Charge: gap-closer only when the target is confirmed out of melee and in range; never toward hazards/raid bosses.
Dash: escape/sprint; breaks roots and kites out of danger.
Tiger Dash: emergency escape/sprint; offered, not auto-fired.
Stampeding Roar: group speed; manual.
Skull Bash: interrupt/kick only on a live enemy cast; MaxDps's interrupt claim wins the slot first.
Cyclone: never-automatic list.
Entangling Roots: root; manual in groups.
Mighty Bash: stun; casting/fleeing non-boss targets only.
Incapacitating Roar: incapacitate; manual in groups.
Ursol's Vortex: root vortex; manual.
Mass Entanglement: AoE root; manual in groups.
Soothe: enemy enrage dispel; never automatic.
Rebirth: battle rez; never-automatic list.
Survival Instincts: major defensive; Red.
Ironbark: external ally defensive; manual (no observable ally state).
Barkskin: minor mitigation; Yellow+.
Ironfur: Guardian active mitigation; Yellow+.
Frenzied Regeneration: solo HP-ladder heal at/below 65% HP.
Renewal: solo HP-ladder heal at/below 50% HP.
Regrowth: on-GCD heal; solo at/below 65% HP.
Swiftmend: instant heal; solo at/below 65% HP.
Aessina's Renewal: emergency heal; last resort (solo at/below 30% HP).
